body: Tesseract Open Source OCR Engine (main repository)
plain_description: **Turn images into searchable text and documents your business can use.** Recognizes text in more than 100 languages and can produce text, PDF, and structured output formats. It can also be trained to recognize other languages.
technical_description: Tesseract is an open-source OCR engine provided as the libtesseract library and a command-line program. Its current stable major version uses an LSTM-based engine for line recognition and also supports the legacy engine. It reads image formats including PNG, JPEG, and TIFF, and can output plain text, hOCR, PDF, TSV, ALTO, and PAGE. It supports UTF-8 and requires traineddata files.
title: Tesseract
